title: FYP Project
text:
Objective
My team and I developed a one-stop shop website for sporting goods where customers can purchase sports equipment and gear, similar to Decathlon.


What I Learned
Through developing this one-stop e-commerce platform for sporting goods, I gained valuable experience in web development, including front-end and back-end programming, database management, and payment gateway integration. I developed skills in e-commerce functionality such as product catalog management, shopping cart systems, and order processing. Additionally, I strengthened my teamwork and collaboration abilities while working with my team, and gained insights into UX design principles and the sporting goods retail market.

title: Data Visualization
text:
During my studies, I worked with Tableau to create visualizations before building dashboards and storyboards.



Quantitative data such as sales figures, survey responses, or performance metrics.
The goal was to understand trends and patterns in the data.




Before designing dashboards, I first created individual visualizations in Tableau to explore the data.
This helped me decide which charts to include and how to structure the dashboards and storyboards effectively.



By visualizing the raw data first, I could identify key insights and ensure that the final dashboards communicated the story clearly and accurately.

title: Reflection on the use of GenAI
text:
How it Helped

Step-by-step explanations for creating pages and editing _quarto.yml.

Suggestions on formatting, bullet points, and Markdown best practices.

Debugged small errors like YAML indentation and Markdown rendering issues.

title: Reflection on the use of GenAI
text:
Benefits

Saved time by giving clear instructions.

Helped me avoid common mistakes.

Made learning smoother and more efficient.

title: Reflection on the use of GenAI
text:
Challenges

Sometimes I needed to double-check suggestions to ensure accuracy.

Needed to adapt generic instructions to my specific project.
